kept.name: architect-loop
kept.reason: A design lesson that applies directly: the repo is the only memory, and since memory files rot, handoffs should be short maps that point to detail in linked files — close to your linked markdown records.

kept.name: claude-api-prefilter-false-positive
kept.reason: A failure mode to know about: auto-memory markdown files injected into every request slowly build up terms that trip the API pre-filter. Relevant to any memory store that gets loaded into context.
